extensionName.description: The extension name shown in the Chrome Web Store and the extensions page.

extensionShortName.description: Short name used where space is limited.

extensionDescription.message: Save all your tabs in one click and get them back. Search, tab groups, restore points, undo bin, backups. 100% local, no account.

tagline.message: A safe harbour for every tab.

emptyLibraryBody.message: Your saved tabs will live here — searchable, exportable, and recoverable. Stow a window to get started.

errorQuota.message: Not enough room to save. Export a backup and remove some collections to free space.

errorRestoreBlocked.message: Chrome blocks extensions from reopening those pages.

errorImportFormat.message: That doesn't look like a tab list. Tabcove reads its own JSON backups, OneTab text, and plain lists of web addresses.

privacyNoNetwork.message: Tabcove collects nothing, sends nothing, and contains no network code at all.

freeForever.message: Tabcove is free, and everything in it today stays free.
